CustomField.formula:
IF (ISBLANK( Break_Start_Time__c ), "",
IF(HOUR(Break_Start_Time__c ) <= 12, TEXT(HOUR(Break_Start_Time__c )), TEXT(HOUR(Break_Start_Time__c )-12)) & ":" &
IF (MINUTE(Break_Start_Time__c ) < 10, "0" + TEXT(MINUTE(Break_Start_Time__c )), TEXT(MINUTE(Break_Start_Time__c ))) &
IF (HOUR(Break_Start_Time__c ) < 12, " AM", " PM"))
CustomField.label: Break Start Time Formula
